description: This bar chart illustrates the runtime comparison of models in seconds. The horizontal axis displays the model names—"Spark," "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude"—listed alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “runtime (seconds),” represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with tick marks at 50-second intervals. There are five bars, each representing a different model; the bars are colored teal for “Our Joint Framework” and green for “LLM Models.” For each model, there are two bars representing the runtime for each framework. The “Spark” bar for “LLM Models” reaches a value of 77 seconds, while the “Claude” bar for “Our Joint Framework” reaches 365 seconds. The “ChatGPT” bars are 190 and 172 seconds, the “DeepSeek” bars are 243 seconds, and the “LLaMA” bars are approximately 243 seconds. The bars are grouped, with each model having a paired bar representing the runtime for “LLM Models” and “Our Joint Framework.” No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
